Track emissions for a single function

carbon_track.Rd

Track emissions for a single function

Usage

carbon_track(fun, ..., tracker, task_id = uuid::UUIDgenerate())

Arguments

fun

Arbitrary function

...

Function inputs

tracker

codecarbon EmissionsTracker object

task_id

Unique ID of function task

Value

A tibble of function results and emissions
